customer_message.subject: chat – shutters stuck
customer_message.body:
Felix Volkov: hi, I have a problem with my flat, Schulhausstrasse 82 in Grenchen, landlord is Domicil Plus Immobilien AG
Felix Volkov: the roller shutters in the living room and bedroom are broken, they won't go up at all. been like this since June
Felix Volkov: so I'm living in the dark basically, lights on all day. I work night shifts and sleep in the day, and now I can't tell day from night anymore, I'm up every two hours and completely wiped out at work
Felix Volkov: no damp or anything like that btw, the flat is dry, it's just the shutters
Felix Volkov: Domicil keeps saying a technician will call me. nobody calls
Felix Volkov: it's a simple thing, the straps are torn, the repair man from the neighbours had a look and said so, no need for any expert, just someone with the parts
Felix Volkov: a friend told me I could stop paying the rent to them and pay it into some official account instead until they fix it. if they don't do anything by end of month that's what I'll do
Felix Volkov: lease is attached. what do I need to do and what do you need from me?
